Écharpe crème, manteau de cuir cuivré croisé en pans diagonaux et ourlet d’hermine.

appearances.designDescription: An original clothing homage to Melancholy Hill: cream rolled scarf; sleeveless asymmetrical copper-brown leather mantle built from diagonal overlapping wrap panels; rust lining; small cream ermine bottom edge. White detached gloves with broad copper cuffs, without arms. Natural wooden Queenie head and orange irises, unchanged chess silhouette.

appearances.designDescription: An original harbor-warden Queenie: sleeveless deep petrol-blue oilskin mantle flowing over her tapered queen-chess body, charcoal high collar below crown, bronze shell-shaped brooch, warm copper waist sash with small rectangular chart pouches, ivory ermine strip down front and complete rounded hem. Two white floating gloves, one loosely open and one slightly clenched. No arms, legs, weapon, staff or background. Warm natural wooden head, orange eyes.

Manteau intégré de matières marines vert sombre, lanterne en laiton incrustée au torse.
Yeux orange, cils inférieurs et deux gants de verre marin flottants.
appearances.designDescription: A complete original undersea-revenant transformation of Queenie as a queen-chess figure: weathered blue-grey driftwood crown and tapered body, coral-like copper crown finial, paired half-lidded ivory eyes with orange irises and black lower lashes, no mouth. Long dark teal seaweed-textured mantle fused into her body with tattered but complete rounded hem, a small inset antique brass lantern inside the torso containing solid amber glass. Two independent pale sea-glass gloves with no arms. Elegant recognizable continuous chess-queen silhouette; no tentacles, human legs or extra creatures. No fog or external glow.

appearances.designDescription: A clothing-only Guinevere homage: preserve natural wooden Queenie head and queen-chess crown fully visible. Royal-blue headpiece sits BEHIND crown with two round side buns each bearing one pale lavender four-point star; do not add human hair. Tapered periwinkle-lavender sleeveless princess dress with white pointed center panel, narrow gold edging, golden waist tabs and small cream ermine collar. Two white floating gloves with lavender cuffs, no connected sleeves or arms. Orange eyes and black lower lashes remain. No legs or feet, no bouquet, no other figures.

appearances.designDescription: An original park-backstage warden Queenie retaining natural warm wooden chess head, orange eyes and black lower lashes. Cream sleeveless work waistcoat over a muted slate-blue tapered robe, brass buttons, navy pointed collar, narrow maroon velvet sash with a small brass wind-up key and two cream tool pouches, simple small amber solid glass badge below collar. Pale ermine rounded base. Exactly two floating white gloves, no arms or legs. Head crown fully visible, no hat, no human body. Crisp clean manufactured textiles and brass, understated worn edges.

appearances.designDescription: A genuinely transformed theme-park queen-chess automaton. Entire Queenie body rebuilt from ivory porcelain and royal-blue enamel shells with precise gold seams. Scalloped ivory crown with small brass top orb, two prominent half-lidded white eye domes with orange irises and short black lower lash pieces. Narrow exposed brass column below head. Elegant continuous lavender-and-ivory mechanical skirt body with four overlapping tapered panels, subtle floral navy filigree, small round brass inspection hatch and full circular integrated base. Two detached articulated white porcelain gloves with gold wrist rings float without arms. No human legs, no extra wind-up key behind silhouette, no weapon.

appearances.designDescription: A clothing-only Kit homage on Queenie: natural wooden queen-chess crown and orange eyes unchanged. Bright golden-yellow cropped sleeveless puffer jacket with charcoal zipper panels and pale seam piping; yellow headband low behind crown without ears or hair. Deep charcoal-and-yellow tapered robe following a continuous chess-queen silhouette. Exactly two detached floating gloves encased in compact rounded yellow mechanical gauntlets with red ring trim and inset violet star-shaped crystal at the back of one glove. No arms, legs, tail, fur, cat ears, mouth or human torso.

appearances.designDescription: An original portal-savepoint keeper Queenie. Preserve warm wooden queen-chess head/crown, orange eyes and black lower lashes. Rich plum sleeveless travel mantle over charcoal tapered robe, jade-green seam piping, small copper geometric clasp below collar, narrow brown utility belt with two crystal capsules, warm cream ermine rounded lower edge. Exactly two independent white floating gloves with jade fingerless cuffs. No book, staff or extra object; intricate savepoint diamond embroidery on front of mantle without text. No human anatomy.

appearances.designDescription: A full original game-avatar transformation of Queenie into a crystalline queen-chess figure. Translucent smoky-violet faceted crown and tapered continuous body, hard polished amber top finial. Two prominent half-lidded pearl-white eyes with orange irises and black lower lash inserts preserve identity; no mouth or human face. Body consists of interlocking violet crystal plates with charcoal sockets, thin warm-gold geometric edging and a large solid jade diamond core inset in chest. Two detached articulated gauntlet hands made of pale lilac crystal with yellow wrist rings float at sides. Full wide integrated hexagonal queen-chess base, no legs, no floating shards, no external glow, no cape.
